OCR PDF

Make scans searchable and copyable with real OCR.

Recognise text in scanned pages and layered PDFs, then either export a searchable PDF with an invisible text layer or pull the text out as a .txt file. Around 18 languages supported.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How OCR PDF works

  1. Add the scan and pick its printed language.
  2. Choose a resolution, then run OCR locally.
  3. Download a searchable PDF or the recognised text.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools

  • PDF to Word — Turn PDF text into an editable .docx.
  • Extract text — Pull clean text out of any PDF.
